The company says it has no reportable segments (2024/2025年报 五、31 分部报告; 分部信息 = 2024年报 第十节 十八、1 and 2025年报 第八节 十七、1).
Sales-mode split (直销/分销) is disclosed only for FY2023 and FY2022 (2023年报).

The new FY2025 product classification (电子元件/电子及陶瓷材料/通信器件/设备组件/其他/其他业务) is disclosed only for FY2025 and FY2024. FY2023 and earlier are not restated to it. 2025H1 and 2026H1 give no full product split: only one 10% row, 电子、通信元件及材料, on the old basis.

The 10% table gives no cost or gross margin for 设备组件, 其他 or 其他业务 (FY2025), for 其他 (FY2024), or for 压缩机部件 and 其他 (FY2023). Prior-year product costs are shown only through yoy % changes, not as amounts. Prior-period costs and residual (non-10%) line costs have been back-solved in D3_top10pct_implied_prior_DERIVED and D3_residual_product_cost_DERIVED; these are derived, not disclosed.
营业成本构成 is disclosed only by industry (行业分类: 工业) for FY2022 to FY2025. There is no 产品分类 table, no separate 能源 or 折旧 line (only 原材料/人工费用/制造费用), and nothing in the half-year reports.
Production and sales volumes are only an aggregate 工业 figure in 万只/万片, mixing all products. No product-level volumes or prices are disclosed, and the half-year reports give no volumes.
Top-5 customer and supplier names are anonymised. Total annual purchases (年度采购总额) are not disclosed as an amount. The half-year reports give no top-5 data.

Employee headcount, function and education are not disclosed in the half-year reports. FY2022 year-end headcount is not in scope: the FY2022 report was not provided; only the FY2022 R&D headcount of 1817 is given as a comparative.

R&D staff are broken down only by 本科/硕士 education and two age bands (<30, 30-40). Other education and age bands are not disclosed. The 2025H1 and 2026H1 reports give only the R&D spend amount, with no R&D intensity %, capitalisation line or R&D headcount.
No nature-of-expense analysis of 营业成本 (e.g. depreciation or amortisation inside COGS) is disclosed. Total depreciation must come from the PPE, right-of-use and intangible notes (other domain).

2026H1 management and selling expense details use new, coarser categories (后勤及办公费, 折旧和摊销费, 差旅及业务招待费). The restated 2025H1 comparatives cannot be mapped one-to-one to the 2025H1 report's line items, so line-level series break at 2026H1.
2024H1 is available only as comparatives in the 2025H1 report: main/other revenue, expense details and R&D. It has no 10% product row with cost.

FY2024 volume commentary: consumer electronics, automotive and optical communications recovered, lifting sales, production and inventory.

policies: Revenue recognition (2025年年度报告 第八节 五、27 收入 (2)): sales contracts usually contain only the performance obligation to transfer goods, and revenue is recognised at the point when control transfers. Domestic (国内业务): recognised after delivery, customer acceptance and reconciliation, when the invoice is issued. Export (出口业务): recognised once goods are loaded and customs export clearance is done, on the export date on the customs declaration.
Quality warranties are assurance-type (保证类质量保证) and are accounted for as 预计负债 (2025年报 第八节 五、27).

R&D (2025年年度报告 第八节 五、19 (2)): R&D spending covers R&D staff pay, materials, depreciation and amortisation, travel, technical service fees and other costs. Research-phase spending is expensed. Development-phase spending is capitalised only when five criteria are met (technical feasibility, intent, market, resources, reliable measurement). Actual capitalisation was 0.00 in FY2021 to FY2025, so 研发投入 = 研发费用.

Segments (2024 annual report 第十节 五、31 and 十八、1; 2025 annual report 第八节 五、31 and 十七、1; same wording in 2023 annual report 五、30 and 十八、1): the company tracks revenue and cost by product internally but shares assets, liabilities and expenses, so it does not define reportable segments.

Payroll (职工薪酬, 2025年报 第八节 五、23): short-term pay, social insurance and housing fund are recognised as incurred. Defined-contribution plans (basic pension, unemployment insurance) are expensed as contributions accrue. The group has 0 retirees whose costs it bears (员工情况 tables, FY2023 to FY2025).
